records.source_meaning: The named product is selling briskly.
records.Japanese:
今は%sが

records.localization_note: The exuberant sales idiom suits this separate trend response.

records.speaker: Shopkeeper
records.context: The shopkeeper reads the local market trend and offers a sales comment or forecast.
records.source_meaning: If the sailor has brought in the named good, the shopkeeper politely asks them to sell it soon at the Market.
records.Japanese:
%sを
仕入れてきてくれたんなら
早いとこ
交易所でさばいてくださいね
records.localization_note: A complete conditional and please restore the courteous tone. Your stock works with both mass nouns and plural goods.
records.english: If you brought %s, please sell your stock at the Market soon.

records.speaker: Shopkeeper
records.context: The shopkeeper reads the local market trend and offers a sales comment or forecast.
records.source_meaning: The shopkeeper rallies to sell the named good and earn a lot of money.
records.Japanese:
さあ
これから%sを売って
じゃんじゃん儲けなきゃ
records.localization_note: Make a bundle expresses the original eagerness and the self-directed pep talk.
records.english: Let's sell %s and make a bundle!

records.speaker: Shopkeeper
records.context: The shopkeeper reads the local market trend and offers a sales comment or forecast.
records.source_meaning: The shopkeeper thinks this trend will probably continue for a fair while.
records.Japanese: この流行はまだまだ続きそうですねえ
records.localization_note: May and quite a while preserve the tentative forecast, which reads smoothly on a single line.
records.english: This trend may last quite a while.
